gaps.explanation: Re-read pp1-10. Nothing printed is missing and nothing is counted twice. Exhibit E (p4) Total Revenues 13,003,733 = General 7,672,707 + Street 2,284,072 + Debt Service 2,171,314 + Other Governmental 875,640. Detail: General Fund Exhibit P (p10) 7,672,707 (= p4); nonmajor Exhibit O (p9, incl. Capital Project Fund) 875,640 (= p4); Street and Debt Service only from Exhibit L (p8, budgetary). Street: 997,799 + 67,618 + 170,923 + 286,864 + 752,385 = 2,275,589 vs p4 2,284,072 (8,483 short). Debt Service: 1,103,486 + 15,347 + 491,869 + 25,377 = 1,636,079 vs p4 2,171,314 (535,235 short; p4 prints Special Assessments 506,076, Intergovernmental 111,730, Interest 9,813, Misc 70,400 which the budgetary schedule groups differently; Exhibit L also prints 'Other Financing Sources' 813,851, in detail as other financing). 8,483 + 535,235 = 543,718 = the gap. Adding p4 Street/Debt Service rows would count those funds twice. JSON statement lines equal p4.

p4 Total Expenditures 11,539,818 = General 7,038,981 + Street 1,285,326 + Debt Service 2,382,100 + Other Governmental 833,411. Detail General (pp11-14) 7,038,981 and nonmajor (p9) 833,411 tie. Street: Exhibit L (p8) Streets 1,022,379 + Capital Outlay 252,901 = 1,275,280 vs p4 1,285,326 (10,046 short). Debt Service: Exhibit L prints no expenditure row; all outflows are 'Other Financing Uses' 2,374,878 (in detail, other financing, label as printed) vs p4 General Government 110,063 + Lease Payments 10,737 + Bond Payments 2,261,300 = 2,382,100. 10,046 + 2,382,100 = 2,392,146 = the gap. The Debt Service spending is inside the 2,374,878 line (cannot be split); adding the p4 rows would count it twice.

p4 Transfers In 445,690 = Street 21,806 + Debt Service 237,374 + Other Governmental 186,510 (Capital Project Fund, in detail from p9). Street's 21,806 is in detail as Exhibit L (p8) 'Other Financing Sources' 21,806 (same amount, printed label kept). Debt Service 237,374 is inside its Exhibit L 'Other Financing Sources' 813,851 (in detail; cannot be split). 21,806 + 237,374 = 259,180 = the gap. Nothing missing.

p4 Transfers Out (445,690) = General (254,797) + Street (190,893). General Fund transfers out in detail (pp11-14) total 254,798 (1 rounding). Street's 190,893 is in detail as Exhibit L (p8) 'Other Financing Uses' -190,893 (same amount, printed label kept). 190,893 - 1 = 190,892 = the gap. Nothing missing.
